Parkinson drug pharmacokinetics and somnolence during prolonged-release ropinirole; normal diet versus fasting, with no identified black-bean meal in indexed abstract.
335 early Parkinson patients randomized to pramipexole or placebo, with somnolence among adverse events; drug comparison rather than a black-bean intervention.
Lergotrile hormonal study in normal men and patients with endocrine disease reports drowsiness as drug side effect; no black-bean dietary intervention.
